name: innovation-proposal
description: Business-plan writer for Chinese student innovation & entrepreneurship contests, by xwu43361-sys. Embeds the official 2026 China International College Students' Innovation Competition (formerly 'Internet+') judging rubric, and adapts to Challenge Cup, Chuangqingchun, Sanchuang, national innovation programs and provincial contests.

description_i18n.zh-CN: xwu43361-sys 的大赛策划书写作技能：内置中国国际大学生创新大赛（原互联网+）2026 官方评审规则全文，适配挑战杯、创青春、三创赛、大创计划（国创）、iCAN 及各类省赛校赛。从项目简介到完整策划书、路演备赛、计划书打磨全流程。触发词：大创赛、互联网+、挑战杯、商业计划书。
